_source: Venom palette from black-metal-theme-neovim (lua/black-metal/palette/venom.lua). Do not edit values here to fix contrast: the build lifts them (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

functional_additions._why: Venom has no real error/warning/diff colors. These are the only hues added, desaturated to sit beside the palette. Used for diagnostics, diff and git only, never for syntax.
